what: real baseline vs Skill on the shipped example (same material, same slide_count, same machine, one run each); both arms are measured from their own .pptx with the same functions
baseline_definition: minimal direct implementation: split the material into N equal character chunks and paste one chunk per page; no ledger, anchors, footer, notes or verification (tests/bench.py: baseline_deck)
limitations: baseline is one honest minimal implementation, not a tuned competitor
one run per path; wall-clock is host-dependent
the shipped example material is synthetic text (no figures, no scanned pages)
failed_mechanical_checks reuses scripts/verify.py, an estimator for overflow and a byte-level re-measurement for the export
sentence_integrity only counts anchored bullets, so a deck with no anchors scores 0 by construction
